title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.06474v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel, holding a noisy draft of the answer at every step. We show that these intermediate states surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, making them a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We further demonstrate that grounding generation in retrieved evidence sharply reduces inter-token dependence, making RAG particularly well suited to parallel decoding. We exploit both through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses speculative token predictions to guide retrieval during denoising. SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model. Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to 4x higher

translated_title: 面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过并行迭代去噪整个响应来生成文本，在每一步都保留着答案的噪声草稿。我们证明这些中间状态在去噪轨迹的早期就显现出关键实体，使其成为检索增强生成（RAG）的有用前瞻信号。我们进一步证明，将生成过程建立在检索到的证据之上能显著降低词元间的依赖性，使RAG特别适合并行解码。我们通过面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索利用了这两点，这是一个动态RAG框架，利用投机性词元预测来指导去噪过程中的检索。SARDI无需训练、与检索器无关，可应用于任何具备推理能力的离散扩散语言模型。在五个多跳问答基准测试上，SARDI以高达4倍的速度超越了免训练扩散和自回归检索基线。
tldr: 提出SARDI框架，利用扩散语言模型去噪过程中的投机性词元预测来指导动态检索，无需训练即可在多跳问答任务上以高达4倍的速度超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: SARDI is a training-free dynamic RAG framework that uses speculative token predictions from diffusion language models to guide retrieval during denoising, outperforming baselines at up to 4x higher speed on multi-hop QA benchmarks.
